status_detail: Early-stage phased plan for nine approximately 240,000 sq ft data center buildings at Lonesome Pine Regional Business & Technology Park, with on-site gas generation planned by Red Post Energy.
notes: Cardinal News reports approximately 2 million sq ft total, each building about 50 MW, gas generation first 100 MW in about three years and eventual 500-600 MW generation scale. Project requires permitting/environmental reviews but no local rezoning because the park is industrial.

project_name: Solis Arx Digital Infrastructure Project at Progress Park
status_detail: Announced December 5, 2025 as a multi-phase AI computing campus on a 99-acre tract in Progress Park; Wythe County page says Fluidstack presented to the Board of Supervisors on June 9, 2026 after acquiring Solis Arx.
notes: County materials state the site is Progress Park Lot 35, marketed/certified for data centers for over a decade, with expected water demand under 2,000 gallons/day and project infrastructure costs paid by Solis Arx. No MW disclosed in official pages found.

project_name: TAC Data Centers Wythe County Campus
aliases: TAC eastern Wythe County data center complex
status_detail: TAC Data Centers plans a large campus in eastern Wythe County near the Pulaski County line; no local rezoning needed because Wythe County lacks countywide zoning, but local building permits and state environmental permits are required.
notes: Cardinal News reports more than 1 GW power need, 9-11 buildings totaling 3.5-4.0 million sq ft on about 1,000 acres, first half online in 2029 and second half completed by 2031 or 2032. Developer is a subsidiary of The Ardent Companies.
